name: hush
description: Review and anonymize each prompt locally before Claude receives it.

allowUnmodifiedSubmission.title: Allow sending the original prompt
allowUnmodifiedSubmission.description: Adds a 'Send original prompt' action to the review panel. It always asks a second time. Off by default.

ruleScope.title: Rule lifetime
ruleScope.description: session: rules stay in memory until the session ends. prompt: rules are forgotten after each prompt.

reviewTimeoutMinutes.title: Review timeout in minutes
reviewTimeoutMinutes.description: A held prompt is discarded after this many minutes without a decision.
